subject: Naolito (The Cute Side of Life): could we be a fit?
body:
{{saludo}}

I'm Nacho from Naolito, the studio behind The Cute Side of Life. Our short film Homework is on Disney+, we've worked with Netflix, Amazon, PlayStation and Nestlé, and our designs have sold in 50+ retail stores across Europe.

We're considering a move into licensing and I've seen what you do with {{referencia}}. Do you think Naolito could fit your portfolio?

I'm sharing our dossier in case you'd like a look. Thank you for your time.

Nacho Arjona
Naolito · contact@naolito.com

subject: Naolito (The Cute Side of Life): ¿podría encajar con vosotros?
body:
{{saludo}}
